description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing a watch notification inbox in a WatchOS app. It includes models for notifications and actions, and a store class that handles persistence, notification delivery, and state management for incoming messages on the Apple Watch.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable class that manages the state of incoming notifications, persists state, and handles notification presentation and user interaction.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, updates state, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores stored state from user defaults during initialization.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Persists current state to user defaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for message deduplication.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps risk levels to haptic feedback types.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft for a prompt action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state to indicate that a reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates state based on the result of a reply attempt.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Schedules a local notification and plays haptic feedback based on risk.
